verdict.rationale: Whether a GPU cloud publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party open-source code or license: the publicly served OpenAPI spec is an interface description, not source, and the CLI/MCP server is an unofficial third-party community tool. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
